release_notes.en: Explorer right-click menus repaired; video tools fixed for windowless runs; new thumbnail tool (smart frame, contact sheet, frame series); license badge shows your plan name.
release_notes.tr: Sag tik menuleri onarildi; video araclari penceresiz calismada duzeltildi; yeni thumbnail araci (akilli kare, kontak tablo, kare serisi); lisans rozeti plan adini gosteriyor.
